content:
You will be given an argumentation and will be asked about to annotate a specified sentence from it for it's argument components.
Annotate the argumentative parts of specified sentence with their argumentative roles such as pro (proponent), opp (opponent) using xml like tags to indicate start and end of a component.
Note that most of the sentences are argumentative. Annotate as much as you can.

Supermarkets and shopping centres should be allowed to open any Sundays and holidays at their discretion. For in this way, Sunday shopping days would be better spread out through the year. Also streets and shops would presumably be emptier as not everyone would be open on the same day. However then you'd have a worse overview of which shop is open on a given day.
What argument components exists in sentence " However then you'd have a worse overview of which shop is open on a given day" from the above dispute? Please annotate the constituing words.
<opp>However then you'd have a worse overview of which shop is open on a given day</opp>
